name: OOTD Outfit Showcase Videos
what_it_is: A batch of short-form fashion clips in which creators film themselves modeling a single look — pajama sets, leather jackets, trench coats, try-on hauls and streetwear — often with a selfie-style opening and a lip-sync or trending audio. There is no shared event; the videos are united only by the outfit-of-the-day format.
